project.name: StreamChatDemoApp
project.purpose: iOS demo app for Stream Chat UI. It showcases standard StreamChatUI implementation with login, channel list, messaging, reactions, push notifications and developer tooling. The provided source is UIKit/StreamChatUI-based.

task.action: Implement AppDelegate as @main entry point that exposes a shared StreamChatWrapper
acceptance: App launches without crashing
didFinishLaunching returns true
StreamChatWrapper.shared is accessible via the chat property
task.intent: Provide a single app entry point that wires StreamChat into the iOS app lifecycle

outcome.user_visible: App starts to a known login/channel flow after launch

los.lo: [skip-jit] Implement AppDelegate as @main entry point that exposes a shared StreamChatWrapper

task.action: Implement DemoAppConfiguration to configure Sentry, Atlantis, and performance monitor
acceptance: Sentry starts only in RELEASE builds
Atlantis starts/stops based on AppConfig.shared.demoAppConfig.isAtlantisEnabled
Performance monitor starts for internal builds after 3s delay
task.intent: Enable debugging and crash reporting to keep the chat app maintainable and observable

outcome.user_visible: No visible change; developers can inspect network traffic and crash reports
technical: Atlantis starts for Proxyman traffic inspection

los.lo: [skip-jit] Implement DemoAppConfiguration to configure Sentry, Atlantis, and performance monitor
